An assortment of parts salvaged
from a High Entia airship.

Wildgrass fit for consumption.
Capils also love the stuff.
Survey license from Ruins Research HQ.

Set of medical instruments suited
to many races and symptoms.
Mythic herb makes even odd food delicious.
Letter from someone linked by fate.

Rusted ID tag.
The name "Aban" is legible.
Soft yet strong vine.
A stone with a charming pattern.

Ore suited to metal engraving.
Also called Paleglow Stone.

Tsukuku's beloved round mirror,
polished to an immaculate shine.

A bangle bent by some kind of
impact. It looks expensive.

Glossy, firm feather.
Shines faintly in the light.

Sechichi's handmade wooden stake.
Used as a survey marker.

Stake taken back from Tirkins.
Dangerous now that its tip is sharper.

Wooden Nopon carving with two faces.
One serene, the other stern.

A well-looked-after camera. The
shutter sound is pleasing to the ears.
Deinos faintly lights the night.
Eluca's vivid colours stand out in nature.

Wanawana's memo. The handwriting
is so messy, it's illegible.

A highly effective medicinal herb.
Heals light injuries fast.

Mineral with the ability to float.
Often found on Giant God's Shoulder.

Beastmeat from Eks. Mild in flavour
and apparently tastier than expected.

Paleglow Stone ring for Winia,
commissioned by Amleto, crafted by Kurt.

Designed by Bartol, made by Alfreda.
Lets anyone catch fish with ease.

Huge cherry clusters on eastern Shoulder.
Large flesh with a delicate sweetness.

Pouch marked "Pororo's Top Pick!"
Seems you dissolve it in water and drink.

Common tool for mining ether deposits.
"Arara" is engraved on its handle.

Ether Pick reinforced by Lott.
More power yields better gems.

Clear crystal with a bluish-white glow.
Its mystery instantly draws the eye.

Prototype Ether Pick made by Gannett,
designed for ease of use by anyone.

Broken and no longer usable.

Dull blue-white-silver shard.
Catalyst for working certain metals.

Ancient food said to taste exquisite.
Lost to time, dried out over many years.

A carrot with all the colours of the
rainbow. The flavour varies per hue.

Bitter grey leafy vegetable.
As fertiliser, it helps plants thrive.

Grain with an elegant, mellow taste.
Thin skin; delicious boiled as it is.

Curious vegetable that lifts your mood.
Packed tight with sweet, round fruits.

Exceptionally sweet root vegetable.
Also prized as an ingredient in sweets.

Prized fish with beautifully shiny scales.
Simmer for a rich broth.

Shellfish with a terribly hard shell.
Its flesh is meltingly tender and tasty.

Mole with wing-like parts.
Legends say it can fly.

A bird with wings as sharp as blades.
Can easily cut branches as it flies by.

An elephant so small it can fit in the
hand. Often hard to spot.

Part shaped like a broken-off piece.
Seems suited to all sorts of uses.
Cord-like machine component made of metal.

Steel rod that chills you at a touch.
Blurs memories before and after contact.

Chain that sparks at the slightest move.
Looks matter more than durability.

Pair of stone-and-machine gears.
Very old, but they still mesh.

Stone named by Nene as she bounced.
Skips endlessly when thrown on water.

Secretly named by Kino. A stick
that looks useful for playing Hero.

Named earnestly by Melia. Its light
chases darkness away and lifts spirits.

Ominously named by Shulk.
Unknown object with a round hollow.

Named by Nene and Kino together.
Lovely pearl that takes ten years to form.

Tiny, light, grain-sized rhinoceros.
Sometimes blown along by the wind.
